invariants.rationale: Collectors.toMap never returns null, so result is always non-null.
toMap uses Pair.getLeft as keys, so map size is at most number of input items (duplicates are overwritten).
If input list is empty, the resulting map is also empty; for null input, the code would throw, but this expresses empty propagation.
Collectors.toMap throws if any value is null, so all map values must be non-null.
Collectors.toMap throws if any key is null, so all map keys must be non-null.
